{{Quote|Scouts report that the Flesh Raider forces are gathering in strength. They already control the mountains around us, and now they're invading the ruins of Kaleth. My men spotted them at the remains of an ancient shrine&mdash;close to your Jedi Temple.|[[Moorint]]|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
An '''ancient meditation shrine''' was located on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the ruins of the temple-[[City/Legends|city]] [[Kaleth]],<ref name="Enemy Force" /> one of the nine [[Tho Yor|Great Temples]] of the ancient [[Je'daii Order]].<ref name="Dawn" /> Accessible by a tunnel in the cliffs near Kaleth's entrance, the [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] shrine was built in a small wooded valley. The valley was largely open [[Grass/Legends|grass]] and [[Tree/Legends|trees]] except for the shrine itself, which was small and was largely in ruins by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Enemy Force" />

During the [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]] by the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s of Tython, a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Flesh Raiders began camping in the shrine. The [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was sent to investigate the Flesh Raider activity in the area, and was surprised to learn that the natives could in fact speak and use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|fought and defeated]] the Flesh Raiders, however, and at the behest of Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] installed [[Security camera/Legends|security cameras]] in the area to make sure that the natives did not return.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ancient shrine appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a class-restricted map for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] quest "Enemy Force."<ref name="Enemy Force" />
